checks.name: the delayed check is due
a missed delayed check is recorded as failed

pseudonymous learner record (no names or birth dates)

findings: After a failed delayed check the skill stays in review for good: skillEvidence (evidence.ts) counts every retention answer given after the due time, and any wrong one fails the check for good, so no later delayed check can pass and verification cannot be reached again. The product rule (returns for review) holds; a path back (a new delayed check after relearning) does not exist yet.
